description: Analyzer output used as QA lead input for test planning in one service scope.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Exact target service scope for QA planning.

fields.name: requirements
fields.description: Functional requirements that must be verified by tests.

fields.name: constraints
fields.description: Testing constraints and boundaries that QA must respect.

fields.name: nonGoals
fields.description: Work that QA should not request or validate in this ticket.

fields.name: risks
fields.description: Risk areas that should influence QA focus.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: Dependent services, APIs, events, persistence, or UI surfaces relevant to QA.

fields.name: qualityFocus
fields.description: Specific quality attributes or behavior dimensions QA should prioritize.

fields.name: edgeConsiderations
fields.description: Boundary cases, error cases, and data variations to consider.
